message.content: {"caption":"Line chart comparing prompt length across training steps for raw-memory and skills versions of Qwen2.5-7B.","description":"The horizontal axis is Step, with ticks at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100; the vertical axis is Prompt Length (Tokens), spanning 1,200 to 1,500 in 50-token increments. The legend identifies a solid blue line as “Qwen2.5-7B (Raw Memory)” and a dashed red line as “Qwen2.5-7B (Skills).” Both series fluctuate. The blue raw-memory series is generally higher, with values mostly around 1,350–1,500 tokens and a peak near 1,490; the red skills series is mostly around 1,250–1,350 tokens, with occasional sharp dips. Thus the skills series generally uses shorter prompts.
